report.title: 2024 Consumer Confidence Report - Santa Teresa MWC

sources_described: Ground Water: Well 01, 9823 Lantz Dr., Morgan Hill. Drinking water source assessment field left blank.

extraction_notes: Latest report on the State EAR portal is the 2024 CCR (dated 6/16/25) even though it sits in the portal's 2025 slot; no report covering 2025 data was found, so data_year is 2024. State SWS CCR template, 7 pages: Table 5 (secondary) and Table 6 (unregulated) are empty; Table 7 (violations) is printed 'NONE'; several template placeholders ('[Enter Additional Information ...]') were left unfilled. Single-result rows print the same number under Level Detected and Range of Detections; range_low/range_high copy that. Some printed PHGs (nitrate 0, fluoride 2) differ from current California PHGs and were copied as printed.
